en-US.description: Back up and restore Microsoft Intune configuration, detect drift and deploy OpenIntuneBaseline.
en-US.longDescription:
TenuVault is a desktop app for Windows and macOS that backs up and restores
Microsoft Intune configuration through Microsoft Graph, using the admin's own
delegated sign-in. It detects configuration drift between backups and deploys
OpenIntuneBaseline. Free for one tenant; the paid Pro and MSP plans add more
tenants, daily schedules, Azure storage and full restore.
en-US.name: TenuVault
en-US.releaseNotes:
Highlights
- Ending a Pro trial early asks first. "Use Community instead" on the trial welcome card used to end a tenant's only Pro trial with one click. It now opens a confirmation that says the tenant moves to Community right away and that the trial cannot be started again for that tenant.
- Buy Pro after a used trial. For a tenant that already had its trial, the License page now offers Buy Pro and the contact for quotes and invoices, instead of mentioning another free trial.
- Tidier trial screens. The sidebar label stays on one line ("Pro trial 14d"), and the trial card has a clearer layout in light and dark.
- Restore dialog. The progress bar stays inside the dialog's rounded corners.
Compatibility notes
None. Licensing, stored data and backup formats are unchanged from 0.5.0.
Changes
- Confirm before ending a Pro trial and offer Buy Pro afterwards (#332)
- Tidy the Pro trial label and trial card (#331)
- Run the HTTPS inspection licensing check as a workflow (#330)
- Keep the restore dialog's progress bar inside its rounded corners (#329)
- Add the 0.5.0 license state fixtures, clear shipped release notes and make the smoke checks follow the trial switch (#328)
Compare with 0.5.0
